name: @keysrun/assets-pipeline
description: Build scripts that turn raw, licensed/third-party art assets (raw/) into the optimized glTF this project ships under apps/client/public/models/. Not imported by any app or package at runtime — see scripts/*.sh and docs/ASSET-LICENCES.md. fbx2gltf is a devDependency here (not dlx'd like @gltf-transform/cli) because it ships a native per-OS binary with no CLI bin entry of its own; scripts/fbx-to-gltf.cjs requires it directly out of node_modules.
